items.stem: A clinic uses patient records to bill an insurer and coordinate follow-up care. Under the privacy framework, this use most likely:

options.text: Is permitted as treatment, payment and operations without separate authorisation
options.rationale: Correct: TPO uses are generally permitted without separate authorisation.

options.text: Requires written authorisation for each record
options.rationale: Routine TPO uses do not each require authorisation.
Such core uses are permitted, not prohibited.

options.text: Requires public posting of the records
options.rationale: No rule requires public posting; that would breach privacy.

items.explanation: Correct: TPO uses are generally permitted without separate authorisation.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Staff email unencrypted PHI to the wrong external recipient. The first privacy-compliance step is to:

options.text: Perform a breach risk assessment to determine notification duties
options.rationale: Correct: a risk assessment determines whether the incident is a reportable breach.

options.text: Ignore it because email is informal
options.rationale: Misdirected PHI must be assessed, not ignored.

options.text: Delete all logs to avoid liability
options.rationale: Destroying evidence is improper and may be illegal.
Media notice is not the first or routine step.

items.explanation: Correct: a risk assessment determines whether the incident is a reportable breach.

items.stem: A new business associate will process PHI on the covered entity's behalf. Which TWO controls are most essential before data sharing begins? (Select TWO)

options.text: A signed business associate agreement defining permitted uses
options.rationale: Correct: a BAA is required before a business associate handles PHI.
Correct: the vendor must commit to safeguards and breach notice.
Marketing materials are not a privacy control.

options.text: A verbal promise to be careful
options.rationale: An informal promise does not meet the requirement.

options.text: The vendor CEO's personal phone number
options.rationale: Contact trivia is not a required control.

items.explanation: Correct: a BAA is required before a business associate handles PHI. Correct: the vendor must commit to safeguards and breach notice.
